requirements.basis: Rows found 100% at 2 cm on early maize (Peña 2013) and at 1.5 to 3.8 cm in sunflower; a 76 cm alley is 15 px at 5 cm. Nothing found measures row finding against pixel size at 30, 20 or 15 in.
Pitch from the autocorrelation needs about 8 samples per pitch after pooling; a 38 cm row at 5 cm is 7.6 px (marginal).
Coarsest published corn stand count 1.5 cm (Ohio, V2 to V4, R² 0.94); counting accuracy collapses on native 0.6 cm imagery of poor quality (rRMSE 0.48).
AP 0.95, rRMSE 0.08 at 0.25 to 0.35 cm (France, 8 sites); mosaics count worse than original frames (R² 0.616 against 0.906).
Position rule validated at 2 cm on early maize; mixed pixels at row edges read as weeds from about 3 cm (sunflower: 71% correct at 1.5 cm, 19% at 3.8 cm).
Weed cover per 1 m cell R² 0.89 at 2 cm (Peña 2013); alley of 76 cm is 25 px at 3 cm.
Four pixels across the smallest object: a 10 cm weed (the US action size) needs 2.5 cm or finer.
The sizer withholds a size under 6 px across; a 6 cm weed needs 1 cm. Measure in the original frames, not the mosaic.
Priors come from region, season and stage, not pixels; any pixel size.

flight.parameter: Height above the canopy for a target pixel
flight.guidance: GSD (cm) = height (m) / 36.5 on Phantom 4 RTK and Mavic 3E/3M; height / 28.4 to 28.9 on Air 3S and Mini 4 Pro at 12 MP (plan with the 12 MP figure; 48/50 MP modes overstate real detail). 0.3 cm: 11 m (9 m). 1 to 2 cm: 37 to 73 m (29 to 58 m). 3.3 cm is about the FAA 122 m ceiling on the 36.5 cameras.

evidence.notes: Air 3S and Mini 4 Pro divisors are our arithmetic from published camera numbers.

flight.guidance: 80/80 for agriculture; 85/70 to 85 for dense vegetation; repetitive rows stitch badly at lower overlap.

evidence.notes: Vendor advice, not a maize study.

flight.guidance: Blur (px) = speed × exposure / GSD; keep under 0.5 to 1 px (sources disagree). At 1/1000 s, 0.3 cm allows 1.5 m/s; 1 to 2 cm allows 5 to 10 m/s; the photo interval caps speed first on consumer drones (Air 3S, Mini 4 Pro: 2 s at 12 MP).
Diffuse light (overcast or early morning) or within about two hours of solar noon; avoid low sun once plants pass V5.

orthoVsFrames.guidance: Count plants and measure weeds in the original frames: maize counting scored R² 0.616 on the mosaic against 0.906 on the frames (MaSC 2025). The mosaic is for the map, rows and cover.
Without RTK or ground control a mosaic can be a few metres off; tie a hotspot to its row through the photo's own pixels, never by GPS alone.

orthoVsFrames.topic: Tall plants at the frame edge
orthoVsFrames.guidance: Lean d = D × h / (H - h): 15 cm at V5 and over a metre at tassel at 40 m, 20 m from the frame centre. Prefer the most nadir view (the app's frame selection already weights angle).

qualityChecks.computedFrom: Map georeference, EXIF/XMP altitude with camera geometry, or the operator

qualityChecks.check: Pixel size within the capability's requirement
Vegetation split above the index of grey
qualityChecks.computedFrom: Otsu threshold of the photo's vegetation index
qualityChecks.threshold: below 0: the split is soil against residue; the ExGR gate keeps the mask to green
No published threshold; calibrate within a flight.

qualityChecks.computedFrom: Share of pixels with luma under 50
qualityChecks.threshold: Over 0.25 of a cell: not assessed (engine default)

gaps: Nothing found measures row finding against pixel size at 30, 20 or 15 in rows.
No published thresholds for blur, clipped exposure or shadow share; they must be calibrated within each flight.
Downsampled fine imagery flatters results against native coarse imagery (Velumani 2021): any score on downsampled data is an upper bound.
